steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Is this thing on? Okay.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Ahem, I'm OwO.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: We've come to Syndicate to recruit! If you're in Syndicate and see this video, don't dilly-dally and come join us right away! The spots are filling up fast!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Also, they always say that Syndicate has a lot of gangs...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I always hear that gangster movies are really popular. Movies from this genre have won a lot of awards.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: But I haven't seen any gangs yet. I don't know where they've run off to... Hey, dummy clapper, what do they look like?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: We welcome any talents from Syndicate who dream of joining the film industry to sign up!

steps.speaker: Pink-Haired Girl
steps.content: Cough cough cough... I can't breathe.
A girl with flamboyant pink hair jumps out of the thick smoke, and starts yelling at a nearby van.

steps.speaker: Pink-Haired Girl
steps.content: Open the door!

steps.speaker: Gloomy Girl
steps.content: We lost them?

steps.speaker: Pink-Haired Girl
steps.content: I set the record room on fire, and umm... Yep, now there's smoke everywhere in the building. They won't be able to get out for a while.

steps.speaker: Gloomy Girl
steps.content: That equipment and those videotapes... were the fruits of many years of our labor...

steps.speaker: Pink-Haired Girl
steps.content: Oh, what are you afraid of? There's new fun in DisCity every day. As long as the two of us are still here, we'll definitely make even better shows in the future.

steps.speaker: Gloomy Girl
steps.content: ...Mmm.

steps.speaker: Gloomy Girl
steps.content: Those of you over there should leave, too. The people in this building are from the Gonzales family. They don't have good tempers.

steps.speaker: Gloomy Girl
steps.content: When they come out and can't find the culprits, they'll probably take it out on you...

steps.speaker: Pink-Haired Girl
steps.content: Huh? There are still people here.
The pink-haired girl looks over towards you. A few seconds later, OwO seems to see her eyes light up.

steps.speaker: Pink-Haired Girl
steps.content: Hey y'all, wanna go have some fun together?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Fun? What kind of fun?

steps.speaker: Pink-Haired Girl
steps.content: Something amusing and enjoyable that makes everyone happy.

steps.speaker: Pink-Haired Girl
steps.content: You must like that, too!

steps.speaker: Pink-Haired Girl
steps.content: How about it? Want to join us?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hehe... How can I miss out on anything happy?

steps.speaker: Pink-Haired Girl
steps.content: All right, get in the van, then!
The pink-haired girl grabs all of you and jumps into the van.

steps.speaker: Pink-Haired Girl
steps.content: Let's go!

steps.speaker: Gloomy Girl
steps.content: I know. Don't rush me.

steps.speaker: Voice outside the van
steps.content: There they are!

steps.speaker: Voice outside the van
steps.content: Don't run!

steps.speaker: Voice outside the van
steps.content: Give our boss's son back!
A dozen burly men armed with guns rush out of the smoky building, cursing as they run towards the van.

steps.speaker: Gloomy Girl
steps.content: Hold on tight.
Fortunately, the engine starts at the most crucial moment. The van rushes out at rocket-like speed, its tires screeching against the ground and whirling up dust.
Ten minutes later.

steps.speaker: Pink-Haired Girl
steps.content: Phew... We finally lost them.
The van speeds down Syndicate's long-neglected roads. The pursuers behind them had long disappeared. They park the van at a place considered peaceful by Syndicate standards.

steps.speaker: Gloomy Girl
steps.content: Do you know these people?

steps.speaker: Pink-Haired Girl
steps.content: No.

steps.speaker: Gloomy Girl
steps.content: Huh?

steps.speaker: Pink-Haired Girl
steps.content: They were standing outside stupidly, so I brought them along.

steps.speaker: Gloomy Girl
steps.content: So... you just randomly got a few passers-by to tag along on our getaway?

steps.speaker: Pink-Haired Girl
steps.content: Not just randomly... Look, they have cameras. Hasn't our "DisCars Special" been delayed for half a month? We can get them to help us film.

steps.speaker: Pink-Haired Girl
steps.content: And can't you tell that these people look really fun? How could I just leave them behind?

steps.speaker: Gloomy Girl
steps.content: ...Whatever, up to you. At least it's better than leaving them behind to get beat up by the Gonzales thugs.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Wait, you... You you you you you...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Could you be... that... What were the names again...

steps.speaker: Pink-Haired Girl
steps.content: Haha, you have a good eye! I'm Love. The driver is Lil Daisy.

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: We're the hosts of Syndicate's most awesome radio show, DeadLover Radio!

steps.speaker: Lil Daisy
steps.content: She didn't even say our names yet...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Oh oh oh! So you're superstars?

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: That's right! We're superstars!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hi there, superstar! I'm OwO. This is my entourage.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I just got to Syndicate. We came to make a movie, and we're recruiting the crew along the way...

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Crew? You're making a movie? What kind? Is it fun?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Of course it's fun! I'm planning to make a gangster film.

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Gangsters? I couldn't be more familiar with them! Lil Daisy and I have been dealing with them for many years. The people coming after us just now were gangsters, too.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: So that's what gangsters look like. But why were they coming after you? Aren't you superstars?

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Who knows? I don't want to talk about it. Going back to your movie, what exactly are you planning to film?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I haven't decided yet. I already have several ideas. Do you want to...

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Count me in! Also Lil Daisy and everyone who works for DeadLover Radio!

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: We'll be where the fun is! That's what DeadLover Radio is all about!
Lil Daisy, who had been quiet for a while, pokes her head out somewhat awkwardly.

steps.speaker: Lil Daisy
steps.content: Can you not make decisions for me...

steps.speaker: Lil Daisy
steps.content: Also, I have to remind you, because we've been getting hunted down these past couple of days, all of our staff have fled.

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Huh? So we've become kings with no armies?

steps.speaker: Lil Daisy
steps.content: ...You're spot on.

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Oh well. If worse comes to worst, we'll switch to the film industry. I'm so excited, Daisy! This is my first time making a movie.

steps.speaker: Lil Daisy
steps.content: I just don't know how capable this crew is...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: We're extremely capable! We'll make a blockbuster for sure! We'll win a DisCars and everyone will watch it!

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: That's great, then! Without further ado, let's get started!

steps.speaker: Lil Daisy
steps.content: I must remind you, there are still people trying to hunt us down.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Fear not, I've got you covered! No one can mess with my crew! Just focus on helping me make my film.

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Roger that, Commander!
